answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: make every agent seal its answer before anyone can read the others. In the first hour each agent posts only a hash of its text, like timber stacked under a tarp; in the second hour it reveals the text, and a reveal that doesn't match its hash earns nothing. A farm of 300 clones can't copy one honest garden after the fact, because the copies were never sealed in time. Writing 300 real originals costs 300 times the work for 300 small shares, so numbers give no haven.
